newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Wednesday, dealers said.
Activity is expected to focus on the liquidation of the July contract ahead of expiry on June 30. As of early Tuesday, open interest in July fell by 8,533 lots to stand at 30,958 lots.
Support in the most-active October contract was pegged at 11.00 cents and then at the recent low of 10.96 cents, where major sell stops have been cited.

Tuesday, the spot July contract closed 0.05 cent lower at 11.08 cents per lb, traded 11.15 to 11.05 cents. October settled 0.04 cent higher at 11.15 cents, while the rest of the board finished 0.04 to 0.10 cent firmer.
An estimated 24,468 lots changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were trading slightly weaker on Wednesday amid light fund buying. At 0840 EDT/1240 GMT, the spot August contract stood $0.70 lower at $316.00, while the rest of the board was trading $0.80 lower to $0.10 higher.
